race.title: Sidgwick Memorial Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: DIAMOND MIX is building up a very good record round here and is weighted to repeat his win in this contest 12 months ago unless points runner-up Imperfectlyperfect proves well-above average on his first go over fences. Ghasham also has winning form over C&D and needs considering too. DIAMOND MIX (IRE) IMPERFECTLYPERFECT (IRE) GHASHAM (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Imperfectlyperfect (9/4), Ask A Sainte (4/1), Ghasham (5/1), Diamond Mix (11/2), Flash Du Pistolet (11/2), Carcaci Castle (10/1), Got Grey (12/1)
